facts.title: Sweet Potato Hash
ingredients: 1 ¾ pounds sweet potatoes (about 3 medium or 2 large), scrubbed clean and sliced into ¾″ pieces
1 red bell pepper, sliced into ¾” squares
1 small* yellow onion, sliced into wedges (see photos)
Freshly ground black pepper, to taste
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
